purpose: Teach: 育毛/素顔/投球/真珠/灯油/ゾウ/主食/鯛

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが育毛剤を試してらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he tried using hair growth tonic.
lines.style: Gentle, distant nostalgia. Soft start on the thought. Pace unhurried, almost dreamlike. A small smile in the voice, remembering something touchingly futile.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、素顔のままお出かけなさったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and your grandfather went out without any fuss about his appearance, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing affection. Quick, bright tempo. A knowing lilt on the contradiction—she's gently poking fun at his vanity with love underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫に投球を教えられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he taught his grandchildren how to pitch.
lines.style: Soft pride in the memory. Steady, calm delivery. Slight emphasis on the teaching—something he valued passing on. Eyes distant, looking back.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祖母ちゃんに真珠のネックレスを贈られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather gave me a pearl necklace, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Brightened recall, almost wistful herself now. Warm and slightly vulnerable. Gentle touch on the memory of the gift. A small, private happiness in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが灯油ストーブを買ってきたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he brought home a kerosene heater.
lines.style: Quieter now. Simple, grounded nostalgia. No embellishment—just a small fact remembered. Warmth in the plainness of it, like remembering small kindnesses.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、動物園でゾウを孫と見られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather took his grandchildren to see the elephants at the zoo, didn't he?
lines.style: Bright and tender. Quick-paced, like the joy bubbles up easily. Light, almost singing underneath—a favorite memory, repeated often.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはお米を主食とされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, rice was the main part of every meal.
lines.style: Observational, matter-of-fact nostalgia. Measured pace. A nod to how things were—simple fact, held with quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お正月に鯛のお料理をふるまわれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather treated us to sea bream at New Year's, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft, warm close. Slightly trailing—she's sinking into the memory. Tender and contented. Like settling into a familiar embrace.
